# testing_discriminated_union_array (Resource)

DiscriminatedUnionArray Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "testing_discriminated_union_array" "my_discriminatedunionarray" {
  items = [
    {
      item_c = {
        value_c = "...my_value_c..."
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `items` (Attributes List) Array of discriminated union items for 'create' operation (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Optional:

- `item_a` (Attributes) Test case - discriminator key 'item_a' matches ItemA, but different model name (tests the bug fix). Has 'type_varying_field' as map type matching ArrayItemA. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--item_a))
- `item_b` (Attributes) Test case - exact match (both discriminator key and model name match). Has 'type_varying_field' as class type (defined properties) to test shared field names with different types across variants. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--item_b))
- `item_c` (Attributes) Test case - missing in 'update' union (only in 'create'). Requires replacement if changed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--item_c))
- `item_d` (Attributes) Test case - model name matches but discriminator keys differ (item_d vs item_d_alt). Requires replacement if changed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--item_d))

<a id="nestedatt--items--item_a"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.item_a`

Optional:

- `type_varying_field` (Map of String) Schema using additionalProperties (becomes map type). Used to test shared field names with structurally different types across discriminated union variants.
- `value_a` (String) Not Null; Requires replacement if changed.

Read-Only:

- `value_a_sensitive` (String)


<a id="nestedatt--items--item_b"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.item_b`

Optional:

- `type_varying_field` (Attributes) Schema with defined properties (becomes class type). Used to test shared field names with structurally different types across discriminated union variants. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--item_b--type_varying_field))
- `value_b` (String) Not Null

<a id="nestedatt--items--item_b--type_varying_field"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.item_b.type_varying_field`

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `setting` (String) Not Null



<a id="nestedatt--items--item_c"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.item_c`

Optional:

- `value_c` (String) Not Null; Requires replacement if changed.
